title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry — Completion Discount Schedule by Registry Type
content:
The completion discount of the Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry lets the registrant or co-registrant buy items still on the registry at a discount during the completion period. This schedule states the product figures of the completion discount for every registry type.

## Rates, cap and timing figures

| Registry type | Completion discount percent | Completion discount cap per registry (USD) | Calendar days an item must have been on the registry before the purchase date | Completion card bonus percent | Finch Circle registry completion bonus added |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Celebration Registry | 10 | 250.00 | 14 | 0 | no |
| Graduation Registry | 10 | 250.00 | 14 | 0 | no |
| Housewarming Registry | 15 | 500.00 | 14 | 0 | yes |
| Baby Registry | 15 | 750.00 | 14 | 0 | yes |
| Anniversary Registry | 15 | 500.00 | 14 | 0 | yes |
| Wedding Registry | 20 | 2500.00 | 30 | 5 | yes |

## Terms common to every registry type

| Term | Value for every registry type |
|---|---|
| Who may use the completion discount | the registrant or the co-registrant |
| Channels | in store, online and in the app |
| Units covered | the requested quantity of the item not yet purchased by guests |
| Merchandise classes never eligible | Fine Jewelry & Watches; Designer Handbags & Luxury |
| Price types never eligible | clearance, doorbuster and final sale |
| Gift cards | never eligible for the completion discount |
| Combination with a percent-off coupon on the same item | the better of the two is taken |

## Notes on the schedule

- The cap is a total for the registry: it bounds the completion discounts of that registry together, not each purchase.
- A completion card bonus percent of 0 means the registry type itself adds no card percent.
- *Illustration (hypothetical):* a Baby Registry's completion discounts can together reach USD 750.00, a Celebration Registry's USD 250.00.
